svg.title: Measured wall clock per workload (split by magnitude)
svg.desc: median over n=5 trials per lane; the line over each bar is the [p10..p90] interval. Shorter is better. Each panel is LINEAR and has its OWN axis - compare bar lengths within a panel, never across panels.
svg.text: Measured wall clock per workload (split by magnitude)
median over n=5 trials per lane; the line over each bar is the [p10..p90] interval. Shorter is better. Each panel is LINEAR and has its
OWN axis - compare bar lengths within a panel, never across panels.
Rows whose two intervals overlap (not REAL) are dimmed and flagged: they are not safe to act on.
